puzzles.name: REPRO v38: bank {1,3} + lt arrow => false no-solution (1x3 | 1x1, left smaller)
puzzles.note: The only tiling is [1 cell][3 cells] with the arrow pointing at the smaller (left) piece. solver-core v38 finds 0 solutions (and deduceSolve ends with none). Works with bank {2,3} or {3,4} (consecutive sizes), fails with {1,3}, {2,4}, {3,9}... Cause: the early check sizesDifferingBy(1) in solvePuzzle (reference/solver-core.v38.js ~line 1275) is used for lt/gt although an arrow only needs two DIFFERENT sizes. Real game puzzle hit by it: Zone3/1408 (bank {3,9} + 4 arrows).
